messages:
elaine (devex): Heads up: support ticket where a user runs `ri quickstart` right after signup, CLI prints `402 Payment Required` and then spins with retries for several minutes. They never saw a billing step during signup.

omar (sdk): can you drop the exact cli log? want to see if retry is in our http client or top-level loop.

elaine (devex): paste from user:
```
2026-08-11T08:21:01Z ri-cli INFO POST /v1/firstcall -> 402 Payment Required
2026-08-11T08:21:01Z ri-cli WARN retrying request (1/5) after 1200ms
2026-08-11T08:21:02Z ri-cli INFO POST /v1/firstcall -> 402 Payment Required
... repeats until exit
```
User ran `ri account status` and saw `billing_state: pending` and no workspace.

omar (sdk): ah, we accidentally regressed in last retry refactor. Node and Go clients now treat many 4xx as candidate for retry unless explicitly blacklisted. Python explicitly treats 401/402 as terminal.

reza (infra): we should not retry 402. It's a billing/TOS block. Retrying just floods logs and confuses users.

omar (sdk): plan: patch the retry middleware to add 401/402 to non-retryable codes across SDKs, add CLI behavior: print actionable message + org id + exit with code 3. I'll add a parity test to the CI matrix.

elaine (devex): Suggested CLI message:
"Account blocked (402): complete billing to create a workspace. Run `ri billing add-card` or visit https://console.redwood.ai/settings/billing. Org: <org-id>. If you think this is an error, run `ri support escalate --org <org-id>`."

omar (sdk): opened cross-repo issue RD-5070, PRs: node-sdk#900, go-sdk#455. Also adding integration smoke that simulates blocked org and asserts CLI exits within 2s and prints the above message.

smoke-bot: node-sdk#900 unit tests passed; go-sdk#455 queued for CI.

reza (infra): I'll add a metric to track "4xx retries" and a pager if it spikes. helps catch regressions.

elaine (devex): For the support case I asked the user to run `ri account status` and share org id + billing_state. If billing_state is `pending` or `blocked` follow billing link or escalate and I'll create a KB note with exact fields to check.

omar (sdk): also adding a small `--fast-fail-on-client-error` flag to the CLI for power users and CI.

elaine (devex): great. marking RD-5070 as "onboarding friction" and will draft KB article once PRs land. :memo:
